details.label: Goal
details.value: Make it clear that closing is a manual action when “Close as Fixed and remove the worktree after Factory Merge” is unchecked. Add a Close button in the flow before the Close block to make that action discoverable.

details.label: Requested proof
details.value: With automatic closing unchecked, complete Factory Merge and show that the issue remains open with a clearly labeled Close button before the Close block. Click it and confirm that it opens the existing closure confirmation. With automatic closing checked, show that the manual prompt is unnecessary.

details.label: Known facts
details.value: At HEAD 5d5defe9, docs/plans/flow-close-cleanup.md states that automatic closure requires opt-in and otherwise delivery ends at Merge. The current scripts/factory-ui/flow-ui.js:2013 contains the checkbox wording quoted in the request. That file has uncommitted changes. No UI behavior was run or verified.

details.label: Constraints
details.value: Preserve the existing automatic-close opt-in and closure confirmation requirements. Preserve unrelated uncommitted changes.

result.summary:
Manual closure is now explicit. A “Close issue…” button appears before the Close block and opens the existing confirmation. Automatic closing hides the prompt.

Formatting/Fallow and both focused checks passed. Browser proof confirms manual mode stays open after Merge and cancellation, while automatic mode closes as Fixed. Merge and Cleanup use fixture operations.

Model the Domain kept visibility derived from existing state. Prove It Works drove browser verification. The change is committed, and the checkout is clean. It is okay to close this chat; issue acceptance remains separate.
